conservative.read: This mode targets around 1.5% monthly return with a focus on capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns compared to other modes.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 3% and 2% respectively.
Reduce AI/Software and Semiconductor leveraged positions (METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to 3% or less.

balanced.read: This mode targets around 2.5% monthly return, prioritizing risk-adjusted growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and limited leverage, aiming for steady gains with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 6% each.

aggressive.read: This mode targets around 4% monthly return, accepting higher risk for amplified growth. It concentrates on high-conviction, leveraged plays, but this significantly increases potential drawdowns and the impact of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.

income.read: This mode targets around 1% monthly return, focusing on generating consistent income. It prioritizes low drawdowns and reliable distributions over growth, with a significant cash buffer. Note that distributions are not guaranteed and NAV can still decline.
